cohort: 53,982 women who gave birth between July 1, 2016, and June 30, 2020, in a single health system
finding: The performance of a risk score for severe maternal morbidity can vary by population subgroups when using standard thresholds derived from the overall cohort.
mod_finding: The risk score for severe maternal morbidity performed less well in those planning vaginal delivery and had different positive predictive values depending on planned mode of delivery.
